limits: Representative cases only; no exhaustive source-cycle, runtime ABI, native or GPU validation is claimed.
Protected-law checks constrain same-interface family mappings generated by this application compiler; they are not a prohibition on deliberate external source edits or new bindings.
Scientific/numerical equations were not changed or independently validated by this rejection campaign.
